---
title: "in shiny"
---

```{r load-pkg, include=FALSE}
library(handsontable)
```


shiny provides the most interesting use of handsontable.

## normal stuff

- config (`handsontableOutput()` + `renderHandsontable()`)
- observers + built-in hooks
- set data for specific cells

## fun stuff

- custom hooks in js + observers eg. click-cell-show-modal-dialog for
  short tables with dropdown menu cols.

### dropdowns in short tables

problem statement: when your handsontable is short, length of dropdowns
will be limited to the table height. users won't even know they can
scroll downwards.

here's an example:

```{r dropdown-problem}
handsontable(
  data = iris[1:2, ],
  adaptiveHeight = TRUE
) |>
  hot_col(
    col = "Species",
    type = "dropdown",
    source = unique(iris$Species) |> as.character()
  )
```

what i do in such cases is add hooks for all dropdown columns:

- when clicked, show a modal dialog with radio buttons.
- when user picks another option from the radio buttons,
  dismiss modal.

this way, we maintain the same number of clicks the user would
have made without the modal.

here's how to achieve that:

```{r dropdown-app-dot-r, eval=FALSE, filename="app.R"}
#| code-fold: true

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(handsontable)

addResourcePath(prefix = "static", directoryPath = "public")

#' The Dropdown Modal
#'
#' Uses bootstrap 5.
#'
#' @return [htmltools::tags]
dropdown_modal <- \() {
  tags$div(
    class = "modal fade",
    id = "dropdownModal",
    tabindex = "-1",
    `aria-labelledby` = "dropdownModalLabel",
    `aria-hidden` = "true",
    tags$div(
      class = "modal-dialog",
      tags$div(
        class = "modal-content",
        tags$div(
          class = "modal-header",
          tags$h5(
            class = "modal-title",
            id = "dropdownModalLabel",
            "Select Option"
          ),
          tags$button(
            type = "button",
            class = "btn-close",
            `data-bs-dismiss` = "modal",
            `aria-label` = "Close"
          )
        ),
        tags$div(
          class = "modal-body",
          tags$div(id = "modalRadioContainer")
        )
      )
    )
  )
}

ui <- page(
  title = "dropdown modal example",
  # i'll use bootstrap 5 for the demo:
  theme = bs_theme(version = 5L),
  lang = "en",

  tags$h3("dropdown modal example"),
  handsontableOutput("table"),

  dropdown_modal(),
  tags$script(src = "/static/dropdown-modal.js")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$table <- renderHandsontable({
    handsontable(
      data = iris[1:3, ],
      adaptiveHeight = TRUE
    ) |>
      hot_col(
        col = "Species",
        type = "dropdown",
        source = unique(iris$Species) |> as.character()
      )
  })

  # detect changes in the table
  observeEvent(input$table, {
    updated_data <- hot_to_r(data = input$table)
    cat("Updated data:\n")
    print(updated_data)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

create `./public/dropdown-modal.js`:

```{js dropdown-modal-js, filename="./public/dropdown-modal.js"}
#| code-fold: true

let bootstrapModal;

$(document).ready(function () {
  const modalElement = document.getElementById("dropdownModal");
  if (modalElement) {
    bootstrapModal = new bootstrap.Modal(modalElement);
  }
});

window.showBootstrapDropdownModal = function (hot, row, col) {
  const currentValue = hot.getDataAtCell(row, col);
  const choices = hot.getSettings().columns[col].source;
  const radioContainer = document.getElementById("modalRadioContainer");

  radioContainer.innerHTML = "";

  const handleSelection = function (selectedValue) {
    hot.setDataAtCell(row, col, selectedValue);
    if (bootstrapModal) {
      bootstrapModal.hide();
    }
  };

  choices.forEach((choice, index) => {
    const radioDiv = document.createElement("div");
    radioDiv.className = "form-check";

    const radioInput = document.createElement("input");
    radioInput.className = "form-check-input";
    radioInput.type = "radio";
    radioInput.name = "modalRadio";
    radioInput.value = choice;
    radioInput.id = `radio_${index}`;
    if (choice === currentValue) {
      radioInput.checked = true;
    }

    const radioLabel = document.createElement("label");
    radioLabel.className = "form-check-label";
    radioLabel.htmlFor = `radio_${index}`;
    radioLabel.textContent = choice;

    radioDiv.appendChild(radioInput);
    radioDiv.appendChild(radioLabel);
    radioContainer.appendChild(radioDiv);

    radioInput.addEventListener("change", function () {
      if (this.checked) {
        handleSelection(this.value);
      }
    });
  });

  if (bootstrapModal) {
    bootstrapModal.show();
  }
};

window.setupDropdownModalHooks = function () {
  $(".handsontable").each(function () {
    const container = this;
    const hot = container.hot;
    if (!hot || hot._modalHooksSetup) {
      return;
    }

    hot.addHook("afterSelectionEnd", function (row, col, row2, col2) {
      const columnConfig =
        hot.getSettings().columns && hot.getSettings().columns[col];
      const isDropdown =
        columnConfig && columnConfig.type === "dropdown" && columnConfig.source;

      const rowConfig =
        hot.getSettings().rowConfig && hot.getSettings().rowConfig[row];
      const isReadOnly =
        (rowConfig && rowConfig.readOnly) ||
        (columnConfig && columnConfig.readOnly);

      const needsDropdownModal = !isReadOnly && isDropdown;

      if (needsDropdownModal) {
        showBootstrapDropdownModal(hot, row, col);
      }
    });

    hot._modalHooksSetup = true;
  });
};

$(document).ready(function () {
  setupDropdownModalHooks();
  setInterval(setupDropdownModalHooks, 500);
});
```

### click btn, set col values

- click adjacent btn, set all dropdown col values eg.
  "Approve All"/"Reject All" btns.

### undo/redo with visual feedback

- cell highlighting during undo/redo: briefly flash to indicate
  changes.

### conditional cell formatting

- heat maps based on cell values

### add margin totals

- row/col totals
